128.method: Unmodified strict FP32 CPU teacher, same affine ROI recropped from raw grayscale frame; no DSP change or retraining. Native head coordinates retain the 224-trained units; alternative target-to-224 scaling reported separately. No labeled ground truth: these are prediction differences, not landmark accuracy loss.
